title: Finite constant pushforward H1 classes have zero image in restricted injectives
statement: Let A be a henselian local ring [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology], f:Y→Spec A proper, and i:Y₀→Y its cartesian closed residue fibre [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square]. Let Λ be a commutative ring and J an injective sheaf of Λ-modules on Y [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Let h:V→Y be finite and locally of finite presentation, M a finite Λ-module, and ψ:h_*underline M→J a morphism. For every x∈H¹(Y₀,i⁻¹(h_*underline M)), H¹(i⁻¹ψ)(x)=0 in H¹(Y₀,i⁻¹J). Cohomology and morphisms use underlying abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology].

source.place: proof Steps 4-7; Stacks 0A5H (lemma-efface-cohomology-on-fibre-by-finite-cover), finite-pushforward lifting argument, 0A48 and 03FD

proof.text: Apply finite_pushforward_H_one_lift_of_henselianLocalRing to obtain z and its naturality equality. Apply subsingleton_H_one_of_injective_module_sheaf to show H¹(ψ)(z)=0. Rewrite the equality and use additivity of the cohomology restriction and comparison maps to conclude zero.
